yt.Title: The Secret Truth About the Glowing Ghost Girls
yt.Description:
In 1922, a classified job advertisement lured young women in Ottawa, Illinois, with promises of clean, healthful work painting luminous watch dials. These girls played games in darkrooms, painting their lips and teeth with radiant paint, completely unaware of the lethal danger. When workers began to fall ill and die mysteriously, corporate giants launched a chilling cover-up to hide the truth.

ig.Caption:
In 1922, a local newspaper ad promised clean, healthful work for young women in Ottawa, Illinois. Girls rushed to join the Radium Dial Company, drawn by the glamour of painting luminous watch dials. 💡✨

During lunch breaks, the workers played a secret game in the darkroom, painting their lips, teeth, and fingernails with the glowing substance. They laughed and beamed, completely unaware that they were coating themselves in a slow-acting poison. 

When workers began experiencing horrifying symptoms—teeth falling out, bones fracturing, and mysterious facial decay—the company launched a ruthless cover-up. False death certificates, stolen autopsy bones, and gaslighting campaigns tried to silence the dying women. 

Swipe through to uncover the chilling story of the Ghost Girls and the fight to expose the truth. 📖🔍
